topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflectors offer robustness against feed element failures but incur reduced gain at high angles. This trade-off impacts link budget margins, requiring careful analysis of system parameters and load conditions. Optimization of array spacing and surface geometry can mitigate initial SNR penalties, while conventional designs benefit from higher SNR margins in the absence of failures.  The impact on latency remains a crucial consideration when assessing performance.
